Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Anita - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Rajesh - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Tanay stands by the road. Anita and Kavya stand near him.]

Anita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay gets on the bus.]

Anita: "Let's see."

[Tanay hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kavya stands in the courtyard. Tanay, Anita and Rajesh stand near her.]

Kavya: "What a nice place."

[Kavya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Kavya (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[It starts to rain.]

Tanay: "Wow, how lovely!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Tanay (surprised): "Let's see."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Tanay (gently): "One more time!"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Tanay stands on the road. Anita and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Tanay, look over here."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Tanay sits in the back seat.]

Rajesh (happily): "What happened?"

[Tanay sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Anita (gently): "One more time!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Tanay in the back.]

Rajesh: "Good job, Tanay!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Anita (gently): "That's great!"

[Tanay's phone rings and he answers it.]

Anita: "Exactly right."

[Tanay sits down on a chair.]

Tanay (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Tanay sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay knocks on the door.]

Rajesh: "That was such a fun day!"
